units: <cite ref="Megillah 21b:6">Meg. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>הרָב את ריבנו</he> who pleaded our cause.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00579">same</cite>. Tanḥ. Naso 12 <he>כל זמן … אינה מְרִיבָה</he> as long as she was engaged in it, she did not quarrel, v. <cite ref="T00847"><he>רָנַן</he></cite>. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ, v. <cite ref="M02012"><he>מְסַרְבַּיי</he></cite>. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 6 <he>כל … מְרִיבִין וכ׳</he> whenever you strive with me, you tempt God. Tanḥ. Mick. 10 <he>עד … מֵרִיב עמו</he> while he was yet in his mother’s womb, Esau was contending with him.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:1">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>שלא יָרִיבוּ זה עם זה</he> that they might not quarrel with one another; <he>היה זה מריב וכ׳</he> this one contended and said, I want to load here &c.; a. fr.
